title: glob non scende nelle sottocartelle
code:
from pathlib import Path
for rel in ["a/P1.csv", "a/b/P2.csv", "P3.csv"]:
    f = Path("d") / rel
    f.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    f.write_text("x")
print(len(list(Path("d").glob("*.csv"))), len(list(Path("d").rglob("*.csv"))))
codeHtml: from pathlib import Path for rel in ["a/P1.csv", "a/b/P2.csv", "P3.csv"]: f = Path("d") / rel f.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) f.write_text("x") print(len(list(Path("d").glob("*.csv"))), len(list(Path("d").rglob("*.csv"))))
explain: glob("*.csv") guarda solo dentro d (trova P3.csv); rglob scende in tutte le sottocartelle e li trova tutti e tre.
